name: zones
title: Surveyed dungeons
description: The zones we have surveyed, with the level band, the experience modifier and how far verification has got.

terms.summary: Use it, credit EQL Source, and read the provenance before you trust a value.
terms.measured: The measured data — drop sightings, damage figures, spell lists — is our own parsed play. Freely usable with attribution.
terms.inherited: Fields sourced from community wikis carry their tier and source. Those values are not ours to license; respect the original source and do not present a tier 5 figure as fact.
terms.warranty: None. This is a fan project and the game is actively patched. Every dataset here states what it does not know.
terms.unofficial: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Daybreak Game Company, Game Jawn or Darkpaw Studios.

stability: Fields in a vN file are never removed and never change type.
New optional fields may be added; ignore keys you do not recognise.
A breaking change gets a new version at a new URL. The old one stays up.
Values change as evidence improves. That is the product working, not a breach — watch `hash` if you cache.
notes: `verify_level` is full, partial or none. Anything not full names its open gate in `verify_gate`.
Verified means checked against source. It does not mean complete.

zones.title: Crushbone
zones.verify_gate: All three gates cleared 9 Aug 2026. Page fetched in full and roster re-compared; history from the API — last edited 14 July 2026, revision 157369, by Mandlz; all 18 coordinates land on drawn floor.

zones.title: Befallen
zones.verify_gate: All three gates cleared 9 Aug 2026. Page fetched in full — all 15 named on the wiki are on the plate and its key items including the Ebon Scythe are indexed; history from the API, last edited 5 August 2026, revision 166594, by Grumpymixon, where the plate had recorded 7 June; all 18 coordinates land on drawn floor.

zones.title: Blackburrow
zones.verify_gate: All three gates cleared 9 Aug 2026. Page fetched in full — all 16 named on the wiki are on the plate and respawn agrees at 22:00; history from the API, revision 165754, 4 August 2026, by Piano, though the only August edits are images so the content dates from 4 July; all 17 coordinates land on drawn floor. Two differ trivially from the wiki — Refugee Splitpaw (mnk) by 13 units, Splitpaw Sharpshooter by 4 — and both readings land on floor, so neither can be shown wrong and both are left as recorded.

zones.title: The Hole
zones.verify_gate: All three gates cleared 9 Aug 2026. Page fetched in full — every named mob the wiki lists is on the plate and respawn agrees at 7:48; history from the API, six edits on 8 August, latest revision 168060 at 21:25 by Mandlz, where the plate had recorded 15 July; all 18 coordinates land on drawn floor.

zones.title: The Warrens
zones.verify_gate: All three gates cleared 9 Aug 2026. Page fetched in full — all 17 named on the wiki are on the plate, respawn agrees at 6:40 and the level range at 4-25; history from the API, current revision 126176, 16 May 2026, by Clowd, and the oldest is 12 February 2024 by P99Wiki>MalleSnow, so the page is a Project 1999 import by the provenance test and the plate already says so in prose; all 19 coordinates land on drawn floor.

zones.title: Plane of Fear
zones.verify_gate: Nothing here is ours yet. The floor plan is read from the game's own mesh, but no coordinate on this page has been checked against it, no named position is recorded, and no figure is measured. Gates 1 to 3 are all unstarted.

zones.title: Plane of Hate
zones.verify_gate: Nothing here is ours yet, and the zone has a second archive - hateplaneb - whose relationship to this one we have not established. Gates 1 to 3 are all unstarted.
